unitTitle: Reported Speech - Reported Statements - Say/Tell - Reported Questions

pairsWith.noteUz: Ko'chirma gap: zamon o'zgaradimi, say/said/told, ko'chirma savollar.

scanNote:
GRAMMAR 2, 14-UNIT MAShQLAR, 2-BET (68-bet, PDF 67). Yuqorida chapda ko'k '14'.

CHAP USTUN:
3) 'First read the following direct speech sentences. In which of them do the tenses change? Why? Then, turn the sentences from direct into reported speech, as in the example.' SURAT: quyosh botishi, palma. 1 "The sun sets in the west," he said. → He said that the sun sets in the west. Tenses do not change - general truth. 2 "Penguins can't fly," he said. 3 "They are watching a film on TV now," she said. 4 "It will be sunny tomorrow," he says. 5 "They visited the zoo last week," he said. 6 "Mammals feed their babies on milk," the teacher said. 7 "We have never been to a circus," she said. 8 "I don't like milk," she says. 9 "They'll go shopping tomorrow," she said. 10 "Mary doesn't speak French," he said.

O'NG USTUN - 'Say - Tell':
4) 'Fill in the gaps with say, said or told.' SURAT: sinfda ikki qiz. 1 "Alright class, open your books to page five," 1) ...... the teacher. "Miss, what's our lesson about?" asked Amy. "Today's lesson is about whales. Now, Amy read the first paragraph," she 2) ...... her. "Sorry Miss, what page did you 3) ......?" Amy asked. "I 4) ...... page five." 2 "Hello, Jan" 1) ...... Oscar. "Hi, Oscar." "I've got some great news," Oscar 2) ...... her. "Oh, really!" Jan 3) ...... . "Guess what! Sally 4) ...... me that she'll be in town for a week!" 5) ...... Oscar. 3 "I'm afraid I can't help you with the housework today," Greg 1) ...... Diane. "That's OK," 2) ...... Diane. "I know you're busy." "But I can do the shopping," 3) ...... Greg. "That would be great," Diane 4) ...... to him.
'Reported Questions':
5) 'Turn the questions from direct into reported speech, as in the example.' 1 "Do you like playing volleyball?" Steve asked Greg. → Steve asked Greg if/whether he liked playing volleyball. 2 "What do you want for lunch?" Mother asked. 3 "Will you take me to the beach on Saturday?" Harry asked. 4 Brad asked, "Have you seen my dog?" (davomi keyingi betda)

Bet raqami: pastda chapda '68'.

exercises.instructionEn: First read the following direct speech sentences. In which of them do the tenses change? Why? Then, turn the sentences from direct into reported speech, as in the example. 1 'The sun sets in the west,' he said. → He said that the sun sets in the west. (Tenses do not change - general truth.) 2 'Penguins can't fly,' he said. 3 'They are watching a film on TV now,' she said. 4 'It will be sunny tomorrow,' he says. 5 'They visited the zoo last week,' he said. 6 'Mammals feed their babies on milk,' the teacher said. 7 'We have never been to a circus,' she said. 8 'I don't like milk,' she says. 9 'They'll go shopping tomorrow,' she said. 10 'Mary doesn't speak French,' he said.
exercises.instructionUz: Avval quyidagi to'g'ridan-to'g'ri gaplarni o'qing. Qaysilarida zamon o'zgaradi? Nega? So'ng gaplarni ko'chirma gapga aylantiring, namunadagidek. 1 'Quyosh g'arbda botadi,' dedi u. → U quyosh g'arbda botishini aytdi. (Zamon o'zgarmaydi - umumiy haqiqat.) 2 'Pingvinlar ucha olmaydi,' dedi u. 3 'Ular hozir televizorda film ko'rishyapti,' dedi u. 4 'Ertaga quyoshli bo'ladi,' deydi u. 5 'Ular o'tgan hafta hayvonot bog'iga borishdi,' dedi u. 6 'Sutemizuvchilar bolalarini sut bilan boqadi,' dedi o'qituvchi. 7 'Biz hech qachon sirkda bo'lmaganmiz,' dedi u. 8 'Men sutni yoqtirmayman,' deydi u. 9 'Ular ertaga xaridga borishadi,' dedi u. 10 'Meri fransuzcha gapirmaydi,' dedi u.
exercises.explanationUz:
ZAMON O'ZGARADIMI?

  O'ZGARMAYDI:
  - UMUMIY HAQIQAT: 1 (sun sets),
    2 (penguins can't fly), 6
    (mammals feed)
  - KIRISh FE'LI HOZIRGI (says): 4
    (he says), 8 (she says)

  O'ZGARADI (said + oddiy gap):
  3 are watching → were watching;
    now → then
  5 visited → had visited; last
    week → the previous week
  7 have never been → had never
    been
  9 'll go → would go; tomorrow →
    the following day
  10 doesn't speak → didn't speak


⚠ 'MAMMALS':

  = sutemizuvchilar.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 He said that the sun sets in the west. (general truth - no change)
exercises.exampleUz: 1 U quyosh g'arbda botishini aytdi. (umumiy haqiqat - o'zgarmaydi)
modelAnswers: 1 He said that the sun sets in the west. (no change - general truth)
2 He said that penguins can't fly. (no change - general truth)
3 She said that they were watching a film on TV then. (change)
4 He says that it will be sunny tomorrow. (no change - 'says' is present)
5 He said that they had visited the zoo the previous week. (change)
6 The teacher said that mammals feed their babies on milk. (no change - general truth)
7 She said that they had never been to a circus. (change)
8 She says that she doesn't like milk. (no change - 'says' is present)
9 She said that they would go shopping the following day. (change)
10 He said that Mary didn't speak French. (change)
modelAnswersUz: 1 U quyosh g'arbda botishini aytdi. (o'zgarmaydi - umumiy haqiqat) NAMUNA
2 U pingvinlar ucha olmasligini aytdi. (o'zgarmaydi - umumiy haqiqat)
3 U ular o'sha paytda televizorda film ko'rishayotganini aytdi. (o'zgaradi: are watching → were watching, now → then)
4 U ertaga quyoshli bo'lishini aytadi. (o'zgarmaydi - 'says' hozirgi zamon)
5 U ular oldingi hafta hayvonot bog'iga borishganini aytdi. (o'zgaradi: visited → had visited)
6 O'qituvchi sutemizuvchilar bolalarini sut bilan boqishini aytdi. (o'zgarmaydi - umumiy haqiqat)
7 U ular hech qachon sirkda bo'lmaganini aytdi. (o'zgaradi: have never been → had never been)
9 U ular keyingi kuni xaridga borishini aytdi. (o'zgaradi: 'll go → would go)
10 U Meri fransuzcha gapirmasligini aytdi. (o'zgaradi: doesn't → didn't)

exercises.instructionEn: Fill in the gaps with say, said or told.
exercises.instructionUz: Bo'shliqlarni say, said yoki told bilan to'ldiring.
exercises.explanationUz:
OLMOSh BORMI? → TOLD; YO'QMI →
  SAID.

  1-DIALOG: said the teacher;
  she TOLD her; what page did you
  SAY; I SAID page five
  2-DIALOG: SAID Oscar; Oscar TOLD
  her; Jan SAID; Sally TOLD me;
  SAID Oscar
  3-DIALOG: Greg TOLD Diane; SAID
  Diane; SAID Greg; Diane SAID to
  him

  ⚠ 'said TO him' - 'to' bor → said.


⚠ 'A PARAGRAPH':

  = abzas.


⚠ 'MISS':

  = o'qituvchi ayolga murojaat.

items.textEn: "Alright class, open your books to page five," ___ the teacher.
"Today's lesson is about whales. Now, Amy read the first paragraph," she ___ her.
"Sorry Miss, what page did you ___?" Amy asked.
"I've got some great news," Oscar ___ her.
"Guess what! Sally ___ me that she'll be in town for a week!"
"I'm afraid I can't help you with the housework today," Greg ___ Diane.
"But I can do the shopping," ___ Greg.
"That would be great," Diane ___ to him.

exercises.instructionEn: Turn the questions from direct into reported speech, as in the example. 1 'Do you like playing volleyball?' Harry asked. 4 Brad asked, 'Have you seen my dog?' (continued on page 69)
exercises.instructionUz: Savollarni to'g'ridan-to'g'ri nutqdan ko'chirma gapga aylantiring, namunadagidek. 1 'Voleybol o'ynashni yoqtirasanmi?' deb so'radi Stiv Gregdan. → Stiv Gregdan voleybol o'ynashni yoqtirish-yoqtirmasligini so'radi. 2 'Tushlikka nima xohlaysan?' deb so'radi onam. 3 'Shanba kuni meni plyajga olib borasanmi?' deb so'radi Harri. 4 Bred so'radi: 'Itimni ko'rdingmi?' (davomi 69-betda)
exercises.explanationUz:
KO'ChIRMA SAVOL.

  HA/YO'Q → if/whether + tasdiq
    tartib
  SAVOL SO'ZI → shu so'z + tasdiq
    tartib

  1 Do you like → if he liked
    (NAMUNA)
  2 What do you want → what I
    wanted
  3 Will you take me → if I would
    take him
  4 Have you seen → if I had seen
    his dog

  ⚠ 'you' - so'ralgan odam (men) →
  I; 'me' - so'ragan → him.
exercises.exampleEn: 1 Steve asked Greg if/whether he liked playing volleyball.

modelAnswers: 1 Steve asked Greg if/whether he liked playing volleyball.
2 Mother asked what I wanted for lunch.
3 Harry asked if/whether I would take him to the beach on Saturday.
4 Brad asked if/whether I had seen his dog.
modelAnswersUz: 1 Stiv Gregdan voleybol o'ynashni yoqtirish-yoqtirmasligini so'radi. (NAMUNA)
2 Onam tushlikka nima xohlashimni so'radi. (what I wanted)
3 Harri shanba kuni uni plyajga olib borish-bormasligimni so'radi. (if I would take him)

patterns.formula: He said that + UMUMIY HAQIQAT (zamon o'zgarmaydi)
patterns.exampleEn: He said that the sun sets in the west. The teacher said that mammals feed their babies on milk.
patterns.exampleUz: U quyosh g'arbda botishini aytdi. O'qituvchi sutemizuvchilar bolalarini sut bilan boqishini aytdi.

patterns.exampleEn: 'Hello, Jan,' said Oscar. 'I've got some great news,' Oscar told her.
patterns.exampleUz: 'Salom, Jan,' dedi Oskar. 'Ajoyib yangilik bor,' dedi Oskar unga.

patterns.formula: KIM + asked + (KIMDAN) + if / SAVOL SO'ZI + EGA + O'TGAN ZAMON
patterns.exampleEn: Steve asked Greg if he liked playing volleyball. Mother asked what I wanted for lunch.
patterns.exampleUz: Stiv Gregdan voleybol o'ynashni yoqtirish-yoqtirmasligini so'radi. Onam tushlikka nima xohlashimni so'radi.
